subject: Remove useless code in sentinel source code (#676)
reason: The change only deletes an empty conditional block in sentinelHandleRedisInstance (an `if (ri->flags & (SRI_PRIMARY | SRI_REPLICA))` whose body was just the comment 'Nothing so far.'). The condition had no side effects and the body was empty, so the compiled behavior is identical on both builds; there is no observable path to test.
